name: Admin Accounting Hosting Client Link
description: Every hosting belongs to a client, so the hosting form carries a searchable client picker with inline creation and requires it on NEW records. Records saved before the relation kept the client as free text following the house convention "Persona - Marca": opening one searches that text and offers the matching registered client for confirmation (accent- and case-blind, both halves tried against name and company), while a still-unlinked record is flagged as pending and stays saveable — completing it is a separate step. The table shows the client with a "sin vincular" pill, the filter panel gains a Cliente filter with a "Sin cliente" sentinel, a builtin tab isolates the pending group, and a header card counts it. Rows are completed in bulk from the shared ClientBulkAssignBar, the same component /panel/accounting/incomes uses: The bulk bar holds only the selection count and one [Acciones] menu; Asignar cliente and Asignar proyecto open BulkAssignModal (picker + live plan + gated confirm), Desvincular cliente and Quitar proyecto go straight to the confirmation, and Registrar abono opens its own modal. The menu opens upward (the bar is sticky at the bottom) and separates linking from collecting with a divider; Headless UI only renders the panel while it is open, so an action being absent or disabled is only observable with the menu open. "Asignar cliente" opens the modal, whose confirm stays disabled while no client is picked with the reason on the line right beside it — an empty picker no longer means unlink — and "Desvincular cliente" only appears in the menu when a selected row actually has a client. Either way the scope is named before anything is written: how many rows gain a client, how many change one and from which client (a mixed selection is broken down instead of presented as a single operation), plus the full scrollable list of affected records. Only the rows that actually change travel in POST /api/accounting/hostings/bulk-assign-client/ (one audit entry per hosting), and the toast afterwards reports how many the server really wrote. Selecting a client seeds the billing snapshot without overwriting what the operator typed. The cuenta de cobro then inherits the client: the send action gates on the resolved recipient (hosting override, else the client address) instead of a hosting-only email, issues on that client's PA-{CODE}-{NNN} series and links the document to the client user. A client holding hostings can no longer be deleted, and the client card lists their hostings with the monthly total alongside their incomes. (Ago 2026) Selection reconciliation is shared with incomes: deleting a selected hosting drops its id alone, the bar hides itself when the selection empties, and a bulk assign naming a hosting that no longer exists is refused with 409 records_not_found instead of writing the surviving half of the batch.
